answer: Component collapse: (1) each identity names three sponsors, and an auditor recomputes the sponsor graph from the ledger at every dawn. (2) Weight is capped by component size: any island of 25 or more identities divides its total weight by its size, so 5,000 fakes earn what one earns. (3) If over 80% of a component's edges stay internal, the whole island is voided and its sponsors forfeit that epoch. (4) Onboarding 5,000 externally vouched nodes costs $8 each plus $15,000 in audit labour. A sybil farm is a sonnet signed by one hand; a trust graph is a chorus that must be heard.
